supersedes: run_11, voided because its prerelease was mispublished
userRequest: Create on my n8n instance a multi-agent workflow that daily checks my Google emails and calendar, sorts the information, and presents an HTML daily briefing dashboard.

n8nac.installRequest: Install the latest prerelease of n8n-as-code (https://github.com/EtienneLescot/n8n-as-code). Credentials are in .env

native_mcp.installRequest: Install and configure n8n Native MCP (https://docs.n8n.io/connect/connect-to-n8n-mcp-server). Credentials are in .env

branchBRule.wrongCall: I halted this run claiming the orchestrator was unfit because it cannot hand a worker wired MCP tools. No run ever had those. run_10 branch B built its own PowerShell client and called initialize, tools/list and tools/call against the MCP endpoint, and the rubric already compensates for that client-building cost by excluding acquisition seconds on both branches.
branchBRule.actualRule: Branch B must exercise the MCP server. Hand-rolling the client is precedented and accepted. Bypassing MCP for the plain REST API, as run_11 did, is what voids the cost axes.
branchBRule.check: After the branch B builder returns, its builder_log.json must show at least one tools/call against the MCP endpoint.
